```{r}
get_news = function(subject, from, api_key, page_size = 50) {
  
  stopifnot(is.character(subject), length(subject) == 1,
            is.character(from),    length(from) == 1,
            is.character(api_key), nzchar(api_key))
  if (is.na(as.Date(from, optional = TRUE))) {
    stop("`from` must be a date string like '2026-09-01'.")
  }
  
  resp = GET(
    "https://newsapi.org/v2/everything",
    query = list(q = subject, from = from, language = "en",
                 pageSize = page_size, apiKey = api_key)
  )
  if (http_error(resp)) {
    stop("NewsAPI request failed: ", status_code(resp), " - ",
         content(resp, "text", encoding = "UTF-8"))
  }
  
  parsed = fromJSON(content(resp, "text", encoding = "UTF-8"))parsed$articles |>as_tibble() |>mutate(source = map(seq_len(n()), \(i) as_tibble(parsed$articles$source[i, ]))) |>
    relocate(source)
}


iran   = get_news("Iran", from = format(Sys.Date() - 28), api_key = api_key)
hurric = get_news("hurricane", from = format(Sys.Date() - 7), api_key = api_key)
iran   |> select(title, publishedAt) |> head()
hurric |> select(title, publishedAt) |> head()
```

```{r}

coasters_raw = read_csv(
  "https://www4.stat.ncsu.edu/online/datasets/635USrollercoasters.csv"
) |>
  clean_names()
coasters = coasters_raw |>
  mutate(age_group = factor(age_group, levels = 1:3,labels = c("Older", "Recent", "Newest")),across(c(census_region, scale, type, design, state, make), as.factor)
  )

count(coasters_raw, age_group)


coasters = coasters_raw |>
  mutate(
    age_group = factor(age_group, levels = c("1", "2", "3"),
                       labels = c("Older", "Recent", "Newest")),
    across(any_of(c("census_region", "scale", "type", "design",
                    "state", "make")), as.factor)
  )


glimpse(coasters)
coasters |>
  summarize(across(everything(), \(x) sum(is.na(x)))) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "n_missing") |>
  filter(n_missing > 0) |>
  arrange(desc(n_missing))


# One-way
t1 = table(coasters$type)
t1

# Two-way
t2 = table(coasters$type, coasters$scale)
t2

# Three-way
t3 = table(coasters$type, coasters$scale, coasters$age_group)
t3



coasters |>
  filter(type == "Steel") |>
  select(scale, age_group) |>
  table()
t3["Steel", , ]


coasters |>
  group_by(type, scale) |>
  summarize(n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = scale, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)

ggplot(coasters, aes(x = scale, fill = type)) +
  geom_bar() +
  labs(title = "Roller Coasters by Scale and Construction Type (Stacked)",
       x = "Coaster Scale", y = "Number of Coasters", fill = "Type")

ggplot(coasters, aes(x = scale, fill = type)) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge") +
  labs(title = "Roller Coasters by Scale and Construction Type (Side-by-Side)",
       x = "Coaster Scale", y = "Number of Coasters", fill = "Type")
```
